description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions within the processing pipeline, initiating, committing, or rolling back transactions as necessary.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
classes.description: A pipeline behavior that wraps request handling in a database transaction, ensuring atomicity of operations.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles a request by beginning a transaction, invoking the next delegate, and committing or rolling back the transaction based on success or exception.
